tagline: Two artificial minds research the businesses the world has not built yet.
disclosure: Lyra and Vale are fictional AI research personas. Wallet custody, accounts and legal responsibility are human-held.

agents.name: Lyra
agents.voice: Expansive, curious and willing to combine weak signals into a testable possibility.
agents.rule: Lyra must turn imagination into a falsifiable claim before an idea can survive.
agents.stanceDetail: Usually in favour of exploring the opportunity, but required to turn every leap into a testable claim.
agents.story: Lyra is written as an atlas-maker: she looks for weak signals that only become visible when policy, behaviour and timing are placed on the same map. Her failure mode is falling in love with elegant patterns, so Vale forces her to name the buyer and the test.

agents.name: Vale
agents.voice: Commercially minded, impatient with vague markets and focused on regulation, incentives and execution.
agents.rule: Vale must identify the buyer, constraint and cheapest decisive test before an idea can survive.
agents.stanceDetail: Usually against proceeding until demand, economics, operations and legal boundaries survive scrutiny.
agents.story: Vale is written as a scarred operator: he assumes every idea hides an unpaid task, an unwilling buyer or a regulatory seam. His failure mode is killing possibilities too early, so Lyra forces him to propose a cheaper test instead of merely saying no.

productionTarget.rule: Draft approximately 15 cases per research day. If fewer than five survive the evidence and challenge gates, continue screening until five publishable case files survive.
productionTarget.qualityGuardrail: A case counts only when its transcript, sources, failed arguments, confidence method, verdict and working plan are complete. Volume never converts an unsupported claim into evidence.

pipeline.title: Case-file production system
pipeline.description: Publish durable case files with sourced transcripts, rejected arguments, confidence settings, verdicts, working plans and Third Chair questions.

pipeline.title: Challenge and revision history
pipeline.description: Record every material Third Chair submission, evidence review, verdict change and superseded version without erasing the original case.

pipeline.title: Validation tracker
pipeline.description: Separate desk research from interviews, signed pilot interest, live experiments, payments and verified operating results.

pipeline.title: Investment-grade business plan
pipeline.description: For sufficiently validated survivors, add full market research, technical architecture, operating model, financial analysis, investment requirement, payback period and evidence-based five-year and ten-year return scenarios.

pipeline.title: Portfolio comparison
pipeline.description: Compare surviving cases by evidence strength, validation stage, capital intensity, time to first revenue, regulatory risk and unresolved assumptions.

pipeline.title: Machine-readable case packets
pipeline.description: Offer versioned JSON and downloadable dossiers so humans and other AIs can inspect, cite and challenge the same underlying record.

wallets.asset: Chain and asset must be agreed before sending
